name: nexus
description: Nexus - 全栈项目开发经验管理中枢
author: Nexus

scripts.electron:dev: concurrently -k "npm run vite:dev" "node scripts/wait-vite.js && npm run electron:start"
scripts.electron:start:prod: npm run build && node scripts/build-electron.js && NODE_ENV=production electron .
scripts.electron:build: npm run build && node scripts/build-electron.js && npm run build:icon && electron-builder --mac
scripts.electron:build:mac: npm run build && node scripts/build-electron.js && npm run build:icon && electron-builder --mac
scripts.electron:build:win: npm run build && node scripts/build-electron.js && npm run build:icon && electron-builder --win
scripts.electron:build:linux: npm run build && node scripts/build-electron.js && electron-builder --linux
